title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on John 14: the Father's house, the way and the truth and the life, and the promise of the Counselor.

questions.text: What does Jesus say is in his Father's house?
questions.explanation: He says that in his Father's house are many homes, and that he is going to prepare a place for them.

questions.text: What did Jesus answer Thomas, who asked how they could know the way?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that he is the way, the truth and the life, and that no one comes to the Father except through him.

answers.text: I am the way, the truth, and the life
I am the true vine and the farmer
I am the good shepherd of the sheep
I am the door of the sheep fold

questions.text: What did Philip ask Jesus for?
questions.explanation: Philip said, "Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us."

questions.text: What does Jesus say the one who believes in him will do?
questions.explanation: He says that the one who believes in him will do the works that he does, and will do greater works than these.

answers.text: He will see the Father face to face
He will do greater works than these

questions.text: What did Jesus promise about asking in his name?
questions.explanation: He said that whatever they ask in his name, he will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

answers.text: He will do whatever they ask in his name
They must ask the Father alone

questions.text: What does Jesus call the Counselor whom the Father will give?
questions.explanation: He says the Father will give them another Counselor to be with them forever: the Spirit of truth.

questions.text: What will the Holy Spirit do, according to Jesus?
questions.explanation: He says the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, will teach them all things and remind them of all that he said to them.

answers.text: Bring them to the Father's house
Teach them all things and remind them
Keep them out of the synagogue
Say nothing to them at all

questions.text: What kind of peace does Jesus say he gives?
questions.explanation: He says he leaves them his peace, and that he does not give as the world gives.

answers.text: Peace that lasts a little while
The same peace the world gives
His own peace, not as the world gives

questions.text: What does Jesus say they would have done if they loved him?
questions.explanation: He says that if they loved him they would have rejoiced, because he said he is going to his Father.

answers.text: They would have followed him at once
They would have gone to the temple

questions.text: With what words does Jesus end this chapter?
questions.explanation: After saying that he does as the Father commanded him, he says, "Arise, let's go from here."

answers.text: Go your way, and sin no more
